gene_context_name, gene_context_id, submitted_gene_symbols and gene_context_source describe a proposition's geneContextQualifier. They are filled in only on SCV propositions; every VCV and RCV proposition has NULLs and an empty list. In 2026-10-18, 6,815,040 SCV propositions carry the qualifier, 6,771,946 of them in propositionPathogenicity.

  • One representative gene per variant. The qualifier comes from the variant, not from the submission. Upstream, clinvar-ingest-bq-tools picks one gene for each variant with its single-gene method: a point-in-time priority procedure that starts from MANE transcripts and gene symbols in the variant's name, then ClinVar's gene associations. A few genes it picks come only from a variant's name and are not ones ClinVar associates; those are not in gene.parquet, so gene_context_id won't join for them. Every SCV of the variant gets that same gene. The submitter did not assert it, and the Parquet doesn't say which step chose it.
  • gene_context_id is that gene's own NCBI Gene coding (primaryCoding.code), written ncbigene:<n> so it joins gene.id directly. gene_context_name is the same gene's symbol. The id is never looked up from a symbol.
  • submitted_gene_symbols is what the submitter named, verbatim. It can list several genes, and may leave out the representative gene: 28,653 SCVs in 2026-10-18 do. From this release the symbols are in submitted order; earlier releases list them in no fixed order.

  • gene_context_source says where the gene came from. It is filled in on every SCV proposition that has the qualifier. From this release.

    Value Meaning 2026-10-18 submittedSymbolMatches The submitter's symbols include the qualifier's symbol, possibly with other genes. 5,890,310 submittedSymbolDiffers The submitter gave symbols, but none equals the qualifier's symbol. Most are a previous symbol of the same gene (GBA for GBA1); the genes are not necessarily different. 28,507 inferredFromVariant The submitter gave no symbols. 891,616 submittedNotNormalized The placeholder: the variant has no single representative gene. 4,607

    Symbols are compared after trimming spaces and ignoring case (C19ORF12 matches C19orf12). That is why submittedSymbolDiffers counts 28,507, not the 28,653 above, which compared exactly. - The placeholder. When the variant has no single representative gene but the submitter named genes, gene_context_name is the submitter's symbol and gene_context_id is NULL. The name is not a normalized gene, and gene_context_source is submittedNotNormalized. Several symbols are joined with , in submitted order (5 SCVs, e.g. DLK1, MEG3). The submitter's genes are still in submitted_gene_symbols. There are 4,607 of these SCVs in 2026-10-18: 4,570 in propositionPathogenicity and 37 in propositionClinvarCustom. Releases before this one name every placeholder with the literal submitted genes were not normalized.

    Because a placeholder's name is now a submitted symbol, a filter such as gene_context_name = 'TP53' also matches placeholders. In 2026-10-18 that is 29 TP53 rows (77 for BRCA1, BRCA2, TP53 and MLH1 together). To get only normalized genes, filter on gene_context_id, or exclude gene_context_source = 'submittedNotNormalized'.

Releases before 1.1.0 have only gene_context_name; the id and symbols are in data (geneContextQualifier.primaryCoding.code, and the submittedGeneSymbols extension). gene_context_source and its geneContextSource extension start with this release.

This is not the variant's gene list. The gene list (clinvarGeneList in variation.extensions) relates a variant to every gene ClinVar associates with it: many genes per variant, including genes a large copy-number variant merely overlaps. Use the gene list to find a gene's variants, as in the gene rollup recipe; use gene_context_id for the one gene a submission's proposition is framed around. A planned variant-gene lookup file will publish the gene list as a gene × variant crosswalk; it carries the gene list, not the gene context.

items.title: scv
items.text:
SCV statements — each submitter's classification of a variant, one row per ClinVar submission (SCV accession). The leaves every aggregate cites.

scv.parquet · 6,853,781 rows · 3.2 GB

Column Type Description id VARCHAR clinvar.submission:SCV<n>.<ver>, e.g. clinvar.submission:SCV000056982.2. type VARCHAR Always Statement. classification STRUCT(type, conceptType, name, primaryCoding, extensions) MappableConcept; classification.name is the submitted call (e.g. Pathogenic, Likely benign) — not case-normalized. classification.extensions may carry the submitter's description. strength STRUCT(type, conceptType, name, primaryCoding) MappableConcept; strength.name is Definitive, Likely, Strong, Potential, or NULL. direction VARCHAR supports, disputes, or neutral — the direction of the classification relative to the proposition (e.g. a Benign call disputes a pathogenicity proposition). quality STRUCT(type, conceptType, name) MappableConcept; quality.name is the submission level — practice guidelines, expert panel, criteria provided, no assertion criteria provided, no classification, or flagged. description VARCHAR The submitter's free-text comment on the classification, or NULL. specifiedBy STRUCT(type, methodType, name, reportedIn, extensions) The method: methodType (ClinVar collection method — clinical testing, curation, research, …), name (the assertion criteria, e.g. ACMG guidelines), reportedIn (the criteria document, one Document shaped like a reportedIn element) and extensions. When ClinVar lists more than one citation for the method, the others are in the extension additionalClinvarMethodCitations (value_document_array, from 1.1.0; 6 SCVs). reportedIn STRUCT(type, pmid, doi, urls, name, documentType, extensions)[] Citations supporting the submission, one Document per ClinVar citation (from 1.1.0): pmid, doi, urls (every resolvable URL for the citation), name (ClinVar's label, e.g. ACMG, 2015) and documentType (ClinVar's citation type, e.g. general, practice guideline). extensions (name, value_string, value_boolean) keep ClinVar's citation text (clinvarCitationText) and any repaired or unusable id; see citation Documents. A Document may have no pmid, doi or urls: a text-only citation carries only clinvarCitationText. Before 1.1.0, a citation with several ids was split into one Document per id, and URL-only and text-only citations were dropped. extensions STRUCT(name, value_string, value_submitted_condition_set, value_submitted_condition)[] Named ClinVar attributes: clinvarScvId, clinvarScvVersion, clinvarScvReviewStatus, submissionLevel, submittedScvLocalKey, submittedScvClassification, and the submitter's original condition (submittedCondition → value_submitted_condition, or submittedConditionSet → value_submitted_condition_set) with its MedGen mapping. Each element sets only the value_* field that matches its name; the others are NULL, as the bundle omits them. Files exported before 1.1.0 filled the unused ones with all-null structs, including empty concepts[] and xrefs[] elements. proposition_id VARCHAR The proposition this statement classifies. Its classification code names the proposition table (see Reading a variant's statements); to cover every code, join read_parquet('proposition*.parquet') (Joining → Seam C). One statement per proposition. proposition_section VARCHAR The proposition table that holds it: propositionPathogenicity, propositionOncogenicity, propositionSomaticClinicalImpact or propositionClinvarCustom, read from the statement's own pointer. Read that one file instead of proposition*.parquet. From 1.1.0. contributions STRUCT(type, contributor, date, activityType)[] {contributor, date, activityType} — contributor is a clinvar.submitter: id → submitter.id; activityType is submitted, created, or evaluated. has_evidence_lines VARCHAR[] Ids of this statement's evidence lines in evidenceLine. data VARCHAR Full JSON object as a string — see The data column. items.title: Pipeline Overview
items.text:
The ClinVar-GKM pipeline transforms ClinVar XML release data into the GKM (Genomic Knowledge Model) schema set (VRS, Cat-VRS, VA-Spec) through a series of BigQuery stored procedures with an external VRS Python processing step.

The two most expensive stages — Variation Identity and VRS Processing — run incrementally: they recompute only the variations that changed since the prior release and carry the rest forward, driven by the release-to-release diff (dataset_diff_on). The downstream gkm_* procedures also have incremental wrappers, but from 1.1.0 the weekly run builds them in full (run-release.sh <date> --full-procs). The incremental wrappers proved no cheaper (about 0.22 TiB billed per dataset, against about 0.20 TiB for a full build) and fell back to a full build without saying so; ADR 0007 workstream 3 decides their future.

items.title: Pipeline Steps
items.text:
The pipeline executes in the following order. Each step is a BigQuery stored procedure unless otherwise noted.

┌──────────────────────────────┐
│ 1. Variation Identity        │  variation_identity[_incremental]
│    Extract & normalize       │  → variation_identity table
│    variant data              │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
│ 2. VRS Processing            │  External: vrs-python
│    Export → VRS Python →     │  → gkm_vrs table
│    Import back to BigQuery   │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
│ 3. Cat-VRS Generation        │  gkm_catvar_proc
│    Canonical alleles &       │  → gkm_catvar table
│    categorical variants      │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
│ 4. Conditions & Traits       │  gkm_scv_condition_proc
│    Map traits, build         │  → condition mapping &
│    conditions & condition    │    condition set tables
│    sets                      │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
│ 5. SCV Statements            │  gkm_scv_statement_proc
│    Build SCV records,        │  → gkm_dict_scv table
│    propositions & statements │
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
│ 6. VCV Statements            │  gkm_vcv_proc +
│    Aggregate SCVs into       │  gkm_vcv_statement_proc
│    variant-level statements  │  → gkm_dict_vcv table
└──────────────┬───────────────┘

┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
│ 7. RCV Statements            │  gkm_rcv_proc +
│    Aggregate SCVs into       │  gkm_rcv_statement_proc
│    condition-level statements│  → gkm_dict_rcv table
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
               │
┌──────────────▼───────────────┐
│ 8. Change log + deltas       │  gkm_change_log +
│    A/U/D per dict + delta     │  gkm_delta_build
│    payloads for publishing    │  → gkm_change_log, delta_<dict>
└──────────────┬───────────────┘
